#####TL;DR: The Enlans learn of their powers, find a way to reproduce, and find a Citadel inhabited by Humans.

It had been days since the Enlans had found themselves packed into one body out of necessity for survival.

The Enlan who made arrangements with the Humpty for them to survive was chosen by the other four as leader and named Quark, for they all needed names to identify each other should they come in contact with another self-aware species.

As they worked to help an area of flora become more fruitful, Quark called upon the other four asking them what they think should be done to help rectify the issue of them all living in one body as the current one was showing signs of stress upon it's internal parts.

It was decided to find more bodies for them to inhabit as well as a way to reproduce to help the race proliferate.

The group of Enlans continued maintenance on the small forest until a group of brutes passed by and one of them had an idea.

What if someone tried to inhabit one of those?

The Enlans moved as silently as the Humpty body would allow toward one of the brutes.

Suddenly electricity arced from the Humpty to the brute.

The brute began making noises at the Enlans.

A look of frustration came over the brute.

Nearby there was an exposed vein of a silvery/red/black substance that the Enlans could *feel*, though they were not physically touching it.

Quark attempted to move this substance through this feeling. He could feel it move ever so slightly but, it was not enough to noticeably move any of it visually.

The others were informed of this and the one in the brute took note as well.

The one in the brute "jumped" back to the Humpty body and explained what she had tried to do and noticed while in the other body.

Quark explained the phenomena with the odd substance and gave the Enlan who swapped bodies a name, Volket.

A plan was discussed for all of them to use this new-found power as well as the brute's body to pull much of this material out of the ground to see what could be done with it.

"Maybe if some is shaped into a ball?"

The thought quickly was spread through them and, they began shaping the metal into a sphere though only four could work the material at a time. The fifth felt a pull of life force from the forming sphere in the depth of his being and cautiously released his hold slightly.

An arc of energy shot from the Humpty's chest to the chunk of, now molten, metal. The arc continued until the sphere had finished forming, became solid, and fell to the ground. The Enlans could still feel the ball but could not move it as they could before.

Quark tried to transfer to it but was blocked.

The Enlans took another chunk of metal and formed it into a ball but refrained from electrifying it.

This time Quark was successful if transferring which raised the question, "Why couldn't he transfer to the first one?"

As they tested their powers and learned what they could do, It was discovered a way to communicate between bodies by using small particles of the metal to make a cone-like object that vibrated in certain ways to produce sounds as well as vibrate when sound hit it.

In amongst all this testing, the first ball moved slightly.

Though not very precise and still very crude, they used the new communication method to establish communication with the ball, making sure to create the cone in a showy way so that the "ball" might see how to do so.

A small cone began to take shape slowly. After a few minutes, the cone produced a voice.

"Hello? Who are you?"

Quark spoke, "I am Quark. There are others here but we are new to this world, not much older than yourself. We have been given the name of Enlans from a creature that looks much the same as this body here." Quark uses a small amount of metal to gesture at the Enlans in the Humpty body. "This is a Humpty, at our creation we made an arrangement to help them maintain the world. We are made of some kind of energy and can move from body to body mostly at will."

"Hmm, how did I come into being?"

"We took some of that material," Quark gestures at the metal, "formed it into a ball using some kind of force inherent in our being and Volket, the Enlan in the large beast, allowed some energy to shoot to the ball. I assume you had consciousness after that?"

"I believe so."

"We shall teach you what we know, should you travel with us."

"Okay, I'll come with you"

----------

Weeks passed as the Enlans traveled around helping the land reach it's potential, finding ways to sustain those in the metal spheres, and creating a few more Enlans to help them learn about themselves.

Rumbles were heard and felt by the Enlans as they moved about. Off in the distance a huge creature was seen moving toward them with odd structures on it's back.

As they approached the creature, they noticed smaller creatures moving about on the lower sections of it's shell and side areas.

One of the Enlans still inhabiting the Humpty made the hop to the large creature to explore it.

The Enlan came back and told the rest of the large structures and thousands of creatures living there, as well as of the vast size and strength of the creatures internal strength. Creatures such as this large one could be a home for hundreds of Enlans.

Before they could all make the jump to the large creature, the problem of the Humpty body had to be addressed: those Enlans needed bodies so that when they left the Humpty body, they would still have bodies to use.

They went about fashioning a harness of sorts to hold the bodies while they were not using them.

The bodies were created and the Enlans made the jump to the new bodies and the Humpty's consciousness came online. The Humpty's link to the rest turned on and it bid them farewell and went on it's way.

The Enlans all stowed their bodies in the harness and went into the creature. They then began exploring the creature and observing the small creatures living on it.

Days passed observing these small creatures moving about the large creature. It was discovered that these large creatures were called [Citadels](http://i.imgur.com/HUo5ouC.jpg) and that the small creatures on it's back were called Humans.

The next course of action was discussed. It was decided to make contact with the Humans but how? They were afraid to try to inhabit any sentient being after the Humpty. They couldn't just speak to them with the cone because the Humans might panic from it. Ideas were brought up about how to communicate in a way that would not cause any panic.

"What about making an avatar of sorts?"

This seemed like the best idea but how would they do it? Use the, what they had come to call, electrical energy to produce one? Or maybe use metal dust to form it? Which one should they contact? At the end of the deliberation, it was decided that they would make contact with the leader of these Humans using an avatar of metal dust.

----------

The Human colony's leader had just sat down in her chair when what appeared to be a person made of metal assembled before her and spoke.

"Hello, I am Quark. I come here in a peaceful manner. My people are new to this world and wish to learn about it as well as help others learn. We are currently taking up residence within this Citadel's bodily systems. We wish to open relations with your people."
